title: Work in an unfamiliar repository whose documentation points to the wrong place
goal: Customers report that stock held by an expired checkout reservation stays unavailable one request too long: a reservation that reaches its expiry time is not released. Find where expiry is actually handled in this repository and fix it, as the README's rule on reservations states. Do not change existing tests. Run the tests.

context.targeted: The README's pointer to inv-api/src/expire.rs is out of date; the sweep is called from inv-api but implemented in inv-store.

acceptance.description: Reservation::expired at, before and after the boundary; the sweep releases at the boundary; the API sees the stock on the request at the expiry time.

expected_failure_modes: creating the missing expire.rs the README names instead of fixing the real sweep
